title: I spent The past 5 months building a NO CODE MMORPG game engine like RPG MAKER. It 80% Done and I need feedback.
author: TheED5
selftext:
More gameplay: [https://youtu.be/y4l75tdIdds](https://youtu.be/y4l75tdIdds)

MMO Studio is a **standalone 2D MMORPG game engine** built to make creating online RPGs much faster and easier.

It gives you the core MMO systems out of the box, including **multiplayer networking, combat, quests, items, equipment, mobs, NPCs, crafting, pets, parties, trading, progression, servers, and more**. You can build **top-down or isometric games**, create projects from scratch, or import existing RPG Maker projects.

The big idea is simple: instead of spending months building the basic MMO infrastructure, you start with the foundation already working and focus on actually making your game.

replies.author: TheED5
replies.body:
The engine is still in early access and still being improved daily. And tbh this engine is more advanced in is current state than rpg maker and other similar game engine. If you actually go see what this does you will be blown away!

Mobile and desktop app so you can build your mmo on the go. Real time collaboration, invite your friends work on the same project at the same time.

Full blown land claim and building systems   
Area: featuring game modes like MOBA, battle royal, free for all, team death match!

Full server sharding throw as many servers as you need to grow! Supports millions of users

Guilds, alliances, parties, raid parties(multiple parties party)

Instances: dungeons, player homes, pvp modes

MCP: control the whole engine with your own AI

Building AI; generate images, audio, connect NPCs to Ai so they can have real conversations with players: 

Engine AI chat: use it to answer questions, build maps, make items, or build your whole game

Lighting, sound, weather, stealth, upgrades, enchanting, pets, Pokémon style battle with pets, breeding pets, farms where you can grown stuff or raise pets 

Many more systems there are over 50+ working system for you to play with!

No 2 games can look alike full UI customization make it look how you want

Been working gon this for 19hrs a day for the past 5 months!
